message:
Implements streaming support for the Marubozu candlestick pattern indicator as part of the streaming indicators framework expansion (Task T129 from specs/001-develop-streaming-indicators).

## Overview

The Marubozu indicator identifies candlestick patterns where the candle body dominates the total size, indicating strong directional momentum. This PR adds real-time streaming capabilities to the existing Series and BufferList implementations.

## Implementation Details

**StreamHub Architecture:**
- Extends `StreamHub<IQuote, CandleResult>` following the QuoteProvider pattern
- Uses non-generic interface per updated convention (PR #1571)
- Requires full OHLC quote data for candlestick analysis
- Validates `minBodyPercent` parameter (80-100%) with default of 95%
- Detects bullish signals (close > open) and bearish signals (close < open) when body percentage exceeds threshold

**Pattern Detection Example:**
```csharp
// Setup quote provider
QuoteHub quoteHub = new();

// Create streaming Marubozu hub
MarubozuHub marubozuHub = quoteHub.ToMarubozuHub(95);

// Stream quotes in real-time
foreach (var quote in liveQuotes)
{
    quoteHub.Add(quote);
    var result = marubozuHub.Results.Last();
    
    if (result.Match == Match.BullSignal)
        Console.WriteLine($"Bullish Marubozu at {result.Timestamp}");
}
```

## New Components

- **`IMarubozu` interface** - Provides consistency across Series, BufferList, and StreamHub implementations
- **`MarubozuHub` class** - Streaming hub with stateless candlestick pattern detection (non-generic)
- **Comprehensive test suite** - Includes rollback validation with Insert/Remove operations and strict Series parity checks
- **Catalog integration** - StreamListing registered and tested
- **Performance benchmark** - Added to streaming performance test suite

## Test Coverage

All 15 Marubozu tests passing:
- ✅ QuoteObserver with comprehensive rollback validation (warmup prefill, duplicate arrivals, late Insert, historical Remove)
- ✅ CustomToString verification
- ✅ Series parity with strict ordering
- ✅ Catalog StreamListing metadata validation
- ✅ Existing Series and BufferList tests remain green

## Progress Update

This completes Task T129, advancing the streaming indicators framework:
- **StreamHub implementations:** 47/85 complete (55% coverage)
- **Overall streaming coverage:** 119/170 implementations (70% complete)
- **1:1:1 parity goal:** Moving toward complete parity across Series, BufferList, and StreamHub styles

## Quality Validation

- ✅ Zero formatting issues (`dotnet format --verify-no-changes`)
- ✅ Clean build with zero warnings
- ✅ All 1,822 repository tests passing
- ✅ Mathematical accuracy matches Series implementation
- ✅ Follows all instruction file requirements for StreamHub development
- ✅ Updated to use non-generic interface convention per PR #1571

## Related

Part of the streaming indicators framework expansion tracked in specs/001-develop-streaming-indicators/tasks.md. Follows established patterns from Doji StreamHub (similar candlestick pattern indicator).
